privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Kindred is a prototype that helps families coordinate care for someone they love. This page explains, in plain language, what it keeps and why.

stores.title: What Kindred stores
stores.body: Your name and email address, so your Care Circle knows who you are. The tasks, appointments and updates your circle adds, and who did what, so everyone sees the same plan.

google.title: Signing in with Google
google.body: If you continue with Google, Kindred receives only your name, email address and profile picture. It cannot see your Gmail, contacts or calendar. Connecting a calendar is a separate step you choose later.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: Only the members of your Care Circle see your circle's tasks, appointments and updates. Kindred does not sell your information or show ads.

notStored.title: What Kindred doesn't store
notStored.body: Kindred is not a medical record. Please don't add medical details you wouldn't share with your whole circle. There are no passwords to store, because you sign in with Google or a one-time code.

delete.title: Leaving and deleting
delete.body: You can leave your Care Circle at any time, or delete your account. Deleting it removes your name and email. Things you added to a shared circle stay, shown as from a former member.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Kindred is a prototype that helps families coordinate care for someone they love. By using it, you agree to these terms. They're written in plain language.

what.title: What Kindred is
what.body: A shared place for your Care Circle to keep track of tasks, appointments and updates, and who's doing what. It's a prototype, so it may change, have mistakes, or stop running.

notMedical.title: Not medical advice or an emergency service
notMedical.body: Kindred doesn't give medical advice and isn't a medical record. In an emergency, call 911. Don't rely on Kindred for anything urgent or life-critical, such as medication timing.

you.title: What we ask of you
you.body: Add only what your whole Care Circle should see. Be kind to the person you care for and to each other. Only invite people who are helping with care, and don't use Kindred for anything unlawful.

circle.title: Your Care Circle
circle.body: Everyone in a Care Circle can add, change, take on and cancel tasks and appointments. Admins can also remove members and make others admins. Anyone can leave at any time.

noWarranty.title: No guarantees
noWarranty.body: Kindred is offered as it is, free of charge, without any promise that it will always work or be available. Notifications and calendar updates can arrive late or not at all, so check Kindred itself for the latest.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: If these terms change, the new version will be on this page. Using Kindred after a change means you accept it.
